features:
- [ADB & MULTI-THREAD] Toi uu dieu phoi giao thuc ADB Transport (TCP 5037) va phan bo tai luong xu ly, loai bo xung dot socket khi quet va thuc thi dong loat nhieu thiet bi.
- [RUNTIME ARCHITECTURE] Chuan hoa tien trinh dich vu nen doc lap (headless background runtime), giam tai UI thread va duy tri dong bo phien on dinh dai han.
- [INTEGRITY & PERFORMANCE] Nang cap kiem toan toan ven he sinh thai 11 Standalone DLL Modules va toi uu do tre I/O khi van hanh Phone Farm quy mo lon.
